Cambodia
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport YES
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport YES
A visa application to enter the Kingdom of Cambodia can be submitted through the government's online e-Visa application at https://www.evisa.gov.kh/.The e-Arrival Card can be filled out by the passenger before or upon arrival at the international border crossing of the Kingdom of Cambodia.Citizens of the Kingdom of Cambodia are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina. Visa shall be issued in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

links.text: the Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
